query:
SELECT bt.id, bt.name, bt.slug FROM businessTypes bt ORDER BY bt.id;
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.businessTypeId, bt.name as currentType FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id WHERE b.id <= 12 ORDER BY b.id;
